UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the application, storing additional profile information beyond basic authentication details. Linked to Firebase Authentication via its ID.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to the Firebase Authentication User ID (UID).

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

role.description: The role of the user within the application, defining access permissions (e.g., 'client', 'admin').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

HostingPlan.title: HostingPlan
HostingPlan.description: Defines the different hosting packages offered by Hostxeon, including pricing and features.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HostingPlan entity.

name.description: The name of the hosting plan (e.g., 'Basic', 'Standard', 'Premium').

description.description: A brief description of the hosting plan.

price.description: The price of the hosting plan per billing cycle (e.g., monthly).

currency.description: The currency code for the plan's price (e.g., 'USD').

features.description: A list of key features included in this hosting plan.

isMostPopular.description: A flag indicating if this plan is designated as 'Most Popular' for marketing purposes.

isActive.description: A flag indicating if the hosting plan is currently active and available for purchase.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the hosting plan was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the hosting plan was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's purchase or subscription to a specific hosting plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who placed the order. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Order)

planId.description: Reference to the HostingPlan that was ordered. (Relationship: HostingPlan 1:N Order)

startDate.description: The date and time when the hosting service for this order started.

endDate.description: The expected date and time when the hosting service for this order will end, if applicable (e.g., for subscriptions).

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., 'pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'cancelled', 'completed').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount for this specific order.

currency.description: The currency code for the total amount (e.g., 'USD').

paymentMethod.description: A description or identifier of the payment method used for this order (e.g., 'Stripe', 'PayPal').

transactionId.description: The external transaction ID provided by the payment gateway.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Records a billing invoice generated for a user's services or orders.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile to whom the invoice is issued. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Invoice)

orderId.description: Reference to the Order associated with this invoice, if applicable. (Relationship: Order 1:N Invoice)

issueDate.description: The date when the invoice was issued.

dueDate.description: The date by which the invoice payment is due.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the invoice.

currency.description: The currency code for the invoice's total amount (e.g., 'USD').

status.description: The current payment status of the invoice (e.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'overdue', 'void').

paymentDate.description: The date and time when the invoice was paid.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was last updated.

InvoiceLineItem.title: InvoiceLineItem
InvoiceLineItem.description: Represents a single line item detail within an invoice, specifying what was billed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InvoiceLineItem entity.

invoiceId.description: Reference to the Invoice this line item belongs to. (Relationship: Invoice 1:N InvoiceLineItem)

description.description: A detailed description of the service or product billed (e.g., 'Basic Hosting Plan - Monthly Subscription').

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being billed.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item.

total.description: The total amount for this specific line item (quantity * unitPrice).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice line item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice line item was last updated.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Represents a customer support ticket submitted by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Ticket entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who submitted this ticket. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Ticket)

subject.description: The subject line or brief summary of the support request.

description.description: A detailed description of the issue or request.

status.description: The current status of the ticket (e.g., 'open', 'in_progress', 'closed', 'awaiting_response').

priority.description: The priority level of the ticket (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent').

assignedToUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (admin) who is currently assigned to resolve this ticket, if any. (Relationship: UserProfile 0:1 Ticket)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was last updated.

closedAt.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was closed.

TicketMessage.title: TicketMessage
TicketMessage.description: Represents a single message or reply within a support ticket, allowing for conversation history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TicketMessage entity.

ticketId.description: Reference to the Ticket this message belongs to. (Relationship: Ticket 1:N TicketMessage)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent this message. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N TicketMessage)

content.description: The actual text content of the message.

isInternalNote.description: A flag indicating if this message is an internal note (true) visible only to staff, or a message to/from the client (false).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

definition.description: Stores individual user profile information. Access is restricted to the owner (matching userId) and administrators. The 'role' field stored here is fundamental for application-level access control.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

definition.description: A collection used to identify administrator users via 'Existence over Content'. The document ID is the userId of an admin. While conceptually an 'AdminRole', it references UserProfile due to the strong association and lack of a dedicated 'AdminRole' schema. Security rules will check for the existence of a document at this path to grant admin privileges.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the administrator user.

definition.description: Contains details of all available hosting plans. Publicly readable for all users. Only administrators have permission to create, update, or delete plans.

params.name: planId
params.description: The unique identifier for a hosting plan.

definition.description: Records customer orders for hosting services. Each document includes a denormalized 'userId' field to ensure authorization independence and allow clients to query their own orders efficiently. Access is restricted to the order owner or administrators.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for an order.

definition.description: Stores billing invoices issued to users. Each document includes a denormalized 'userId' field for authorization independence. Clients can only read their own invoices, while administrators can view all.

params.name: invoiceId
params.description: The unique identifier for an invoice.

definition.description: Details individual line items within an invoice. Each document includes a denormalized 'invoiceOwnerId' (from the parent Invoice's userId) for authorization independence, eliminating `get()` calls in rules. Read access is granted to the invoice owner and administrators.

params.name: invoiceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent invoice.

params.name: lineItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for an invoice line item.

definition.description: Manages customer support tickets. Each document includes a denormalized 'userId' field (the ticket creator) for authorization independence. Access is granted to the ticket owner and administrators for reading and updating.

params.name: ticketId
params.description: The unique identifier for a support ticket.

definition.description: Contains messages exchanged within a support ticket. Each document includes denormalized 'ticketOwnerId' (from the parent Ticket's userId) for authorization independence, and 'messageSenderId'. Clients can only read messages where 'isInternalNote' is false and are restricted to their own tickets. Administrators have full read/write access and can post internal notes.

params.name: ticketId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent support ticket.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for a message within a ticket.
